items.name: Bastard Sword
items.description: This broad-bladed sword, sometimes called the hand-and-a-half sword, has a longer grip so it can be held in one hand or used with two hands to provide extra piercing or slashing power.

items.name: Dread Ampoule (Moderate)
items.description:
Usage held in 1 hand

Activate A Strike

This flask is filled with a murky purple gas that briefly interferes with normal brain activity. A dread ampoule deals the listed mental damage and mental splash damage.

On a hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}, or frightened 2 on a critical hit. Many types also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 2d6 mental damage and 2 mental splash damage.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: This thin spear is well balanced for throwing but is not designed for melee use.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

items.name: Bone Religious Symbol (Venexus)
items.description: This piece of bone is emblazoned with an image representing Venexus. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity as a divine focus to use certain abilities and cast some spells. A religious symbol must be held in one hand to use it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The bone warrior Strides twice. If they end their movement within melee reach of an enemy, the bone warrior makes a melee Strike against that enemy.
